category.name: Travel
category.description: Bandara, hotel, dan percakapan saat bepergian.

words.definition: The bags and suitcases you take when travelling.
words.example: My luggage is too heavy to carry.
words.example_id: Bagasi saya terlalu berat untuk dibawa.

words.definition: A detailed plan of a journey.
words.example: Our itinerary includes three cities.
words.example_id: Rencana perjalanan kami mencakup tiga kota.

words.definition: The act of getting on a plane or ship.
words.example: Boarding starts thirty minutes before departure.
words.example_id: Boarding dimulai tiga puluh menit sebelum keberangkatan.

words.definition: An official document needed to travel abroad.
words.example: Keep your passport in a safe place.
words.example_id: Simpan paspormu di tempat aman.

words.definition: The act of leaving, especially on a journey.
words.example: The departure time is six in the morning.
words.example_id: Waktu keberangkatan pukul enam pagi.

words.definition: A place to stay while travelling.
words.example: We booked cheap accommodation near the beach.
words.example_id: Kami memesan penginapan murah dekat pantai.

words.definition: Something you buy to remember a place.
words.example: I bought a small souvenir for my sister.
words.example_id: Saya membeli cendera mata kecil untuk adik saya.

words.definition: Stopping at a place on the way to another.
words.example: We have a two-hour transit in Singapore.
words.example_id: Kami transit dua jam di Singapura.

words.definition: The money used in a particular country.
words.example: Where can I exchange foreign currency?
words.example_id: Di mana saya bisa menukar mata uang asing?

words.definition: An arrangement to keep a seat or room for you.
words.example: I have a reservation for two nights.
words.example_id: Saya punya pemesanan untuk dua malam.

words.definition: A narrow passage between rows of seats.
words.example: I prefer an aisle seat on the plane.
words.example_id: Saya lebih suka kursi lorong di pesawat.

words.definition: The place where officials check goods entering a country.
words.example: We passed through customs quickly.
words.example_id: Kami melewati bea cukai dengan cepat.

words.definition: A situation when something happens later than planned.
words.example: The flight has a two-hour delay.
words.example_id: Penerbangan itu tertunda dua jam.

words.definition: The place you are travelling to.
words.example: Bali is a popular holiday destination.
words.example_id: Bali adalah tujuan liburan populer.

words.definition: To give something and receive something else.
words.example: Where can I exchange my money?
words.example_id: Di mana saya bisa menukar uang saya?

words.definition: A journey by aeroplane.
words.example: Our flight leaves at dawn.
words.example_id: Penerbangan kami berangkat saat fajar.

words.definition: The place in an airport where you board a plane.
words.example: Boarding is at gate seven.
words.example_id: Boarding di gerbang tujuh.

words.definition: A person or book that shows you around.
words.example: The guide explained the temple's history.
words.example_id: Pemandu menjelaskan sejarah candi itu.

words.definition: A cheap place to sleep, often for young travellers.
words.example: We stayed in a hostel near the station.
words.example_id: Kami menginap di hostel dekat stasiun.

words.definition: A famous building or place easy to recognise.
words.example: The mosque is a well-known landmark.
words.example_id: Masjid itu adalah penanda yang terkenal.

words.definition: Relating to the area where you are.
words.example: Try the local food at the market.
words.example_id: Cobalah makanan lokal di pasar.

words.definition: A drawing of an area showing roads and places.
words.example: Download the map before you go.
words.example_id: Unduh petanya sebelum berangkat.

words.definition: The raised area beside a railway track.
words.example: The train departs from platform three.
words.example_id: Kereta berangkat dari peron tiga.

words.definition: To go back to a place.
words.example: We return home on Sunday.
words.example_id: Kami kembali ke rumah hari Minggu.

words.definition: The way from one place to another.
words.example: The mountain route is more scenic.
words.example_id: Rute pegunungan lebih indah.

words.definition: The natural beauty of an area.
words.example: The scenery along the coast is stunning.
words.example_id: Pemandangan di sepanjang pantai sangat memukau.

words.definition: A paper or digital pass for travel or entry.
words.example: I bought two train tickets.
words.example_id: Saya membeli dua tiket kereta.

words.definition: A journey to visit interesting places.
words.example: We joined a half-day city tour.
words.example_id: Kami ikut tur kota setengah hari.

words.definition: Official permission to enter a country.
words.example: Apply for the visa two months early.
words.example_id: Ajukan visa dua bulan lebih awal.

words.definition: To walk around slowly without a clear direction.
words.example: We wandered through the old town.
words.example_id: Kami berkeliling kota tua tanpa tujuan.

words.definition: The bags you carry when travelling.
words.example: Please keep your baggage with you.
words.example_id: Mohon bawa barang bawaanmu.

words.definition: An arrangement made in advance.
words.example: I made a booking for two rooms.
words.example_id: Saya memesan dua kamar.

words.definition: To say something planned will not happen.
words.example: We had to cancel the trip.
words.example_id: Kami harus membatalkan perjalanan.

words.definition: A boat that carries people across water.
words.example: The ferry leaves every hour.
words.example_id: Kapal feri berangkat setiap jam.

words.definition: Protection you pay for in case of problems.
words.example: Travel insurance saved us money.
words.example_id: Asuransi perjalanan menghemat uang kami.

words.definition: Tiredness after flying across time zones.
words.example: It took days to recover from jet lag.
words.example_id: Butuh beberapa hari untuk pulih dari jet lag.

words.definition: Visiting interesting places as a tourist.
words.example: We spent the morning sightseeing.
words.example_id: Kami menghabiskan pagi berkeliling melihat tempat wisata.

words.definition: A long walk, often in nature.
words.example: We trekked to the waterfall.
words.example_id: Kami mendaki ke air terjun.

words.definition: A vehicle that travels between two places often.
words.example: The hotel shuttle runs every 30 minutes.
words.example_id: Bus antar-jemput hotel berjalan setiap 30 menit.
